definitions.gloss: to fulfill, to accomplish, to carry out
definitions.explanation: To complete a duty, promise, or goal; to achieve what was intended.

examples.japanese: {各々|おのおの}が{自分|じぶん}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たした。
{夢|ゆめ}を{果|は}たすために{努力|どりょく}する。
examples.english: To work hard to achieve one's dream.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{果|は}たす.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす (to fulfill a role)
・{約束|やくそく}を{果|は}たす (to keep a promise)
・{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす (to fulfill responsibility)
・{義務|ぎむ}を{果|は}たす (to carry out one's duty)
・{目的|もくてき}を{果|は}たす (to achieve one's purpose)

RELATED:
・{果|は}たして (as expected; indeed)
